## Parent

[#456](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/456)

## What to build

The Source UI counts all retained upload rows toward a fixed limit of 16. Completed/failed history can disable add, replacement and resume even when active Source capacity is available.

Found by the subsequent #456 audit at main commit dc17dead07c1d1f66e1806412cb7623812601bf1.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Accept 16 Sources, withdraw one, then add another and replace an active Source without reloading the page.
- [ ] Completed/failed rows do not permanently consume intake capacity; preserve independent failure retry and saved-candidate recovery.
- [ ] Keep server-authoritative membership limits and bounded pending UI work; add workflow and browser regressions.
- [ ] Demonstrate the regression before the repair and validate the fix at the relevant test boundaries.

## Blocked by

None. Repair now; do not wait for later rendition specifications. Coordinate overlapping files with other repair tickets.

## Parent

[#456](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/456)

## What to build

Source transactions load, scan and rewrite the entire retained candidate history; paging the response afterward does not bound persistence work.

Original reproduction and review evidence: [#538](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/538), concern 4.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Bound lookup, mutation and pagination work independently of historical candidate count at the real persistence boundary.
- [ ] Preserve equal replay, conflicting reuse, exact candidate status, rollback and current-policy/concurrency fencing.
- [ ] Add a growing-history regression without imposing a lifetime Author quota or discarding replay responsibility.
- [ ] Demonstrate the regression before the repair and validate the fix at the relevant test boundaries.

## Blocked by

None. Repair now; do not wait for later rendition specifications. Coordinate overlapping files with other repair tickets.

## Parent

[#456](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/456)

## What to build

A broker peer that accepts TCP but never sends NATS INFO can leave a live socket after connection timeout or runtime disposal.

Original reproduction and review evidence: [#538](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/538), concern 3.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Reproduce through actual User and Wallpaper adapter acquisition paths and audit equivalent new Asset worker connections.
- [ ] Close underlying transports on failed startup, cancellation and disposal; preserve successful connection/shutdown behavior.
- [ ] Verify native socket closure rather than only timing out the caller.
- [ ] Demonstrate the regression before the repair and validate the fix at the relevant test boundaries.

## Blocked by

None. Repair now; do not wait for later rendition specifications. Coordinate overlapping files with other repair tickets.

## Parent

[#456](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/456)

## What to build

Wallpaper listing lacks the request cancellation used by adjacent routes, leaving work running after client disconnect or UI abandonment.

Original reproduction and review evidence: [#538](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/538), concern 7.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Disconnect a real HTTP list request with a pending controlled operation and verify underlying cancellation.
- [ ] Verify bounded shutdown cleanup and retain a successful-request control.
- [ ] Keep UI navigation/session cancellation connected to the actual request lifetime.
- [ ] Demonstrate the regression before the repair and validate the fix at the relevant test boundaries.

## Blocked by

None. Repair now; do not wait for later rendition specifications. Coordinate overlapping files with other repair tickets.

## Parent

[#456](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/456)

## What to build

A permitted animation can exceed the inspector's 16-KiB facts-response limit, causing deterministic worker failure while the candidate remains inspecting.

Original reproduction and review evidence: [#538](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/538), concern 9.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Exercise the recorded 1,850-frame WebP case under its supported configured picture policy through the real inspection/candidate-status path.
- [ ] Supported input reaches a correct durable outcome; internal protocol bounds agree with effective input policy and measured operational constraints.
- [ ] Preserve timing, loop, cancellation/reaping and valid controls; do not invent an Author restriction to hide the mismatch.
- [ ] Demonstrate the regression before the repair and validate the fix at the relevant test boundaries.

## Blocked by

None. Repair now; do not wait for later rendition specifications. Coordinate overlapping files with other repair tickets.
